title: CoOp task prompt bank replaced by structured Mirror code
hypothesis: A small domain phase code on shared CoOp context tokens preserves base-to-novel classification across four visual domains with less prompt storage than independent domain contexts, while adding value beyond a matched native scalar control.
physical_object: frozen openai/clip-vit-base-patch32 vision/text model and a shared four-token CoOp context basis
mirror_coordinate: one domain angle applying Givens rotations to context-token pairs (0,1) and (2,3)

development.batch: all selected base examples across domains
development.selection_metric: base/novel accuracy and harmonic mean; no official test split used for tuning

fresh.classes: all ten; novel classes 6-9 are primary generalization audit

storage.prompt_format: UTF-8 JSON header plus contiguous little-endian float32 arrays
storage.full_bundle_bytes: sum of exact CLIP model/tokenizer/processor file sizes plus exact serialized prompt payload bytes

success_gate: Mirror base/novel harmonic mean within 1 pp of independent-domain CoOp; >=25% fewer prompt bytes than independent; >=2 pp novel accuracy over shared CoOp.
failure_gate: Native scalar Givens control matches Mirror within 0.1 pp, or quality/storage gate fails.
boundaries: no broad VLM or production claim
fresh audit not used for tuning
